property: The model has one assertion, checked in every cycle: !rst -> (!(chosen & o_grant_vec_ref[arbitrary_requester]) || ~in_req_vec[another_arbitrary_requester] || ranks[arbitrary_requester] < ranks[another_arbitrary_requester]).
mem_havoc: The ranks array is flattened into registers; abstract_state on a register or a slice of it is a rank havoc.
